title: Tataka is slain
introduction: Rama encounters his first problem-female demoness Tataka, also called as Taadaka, and eliminates her at the orders of sage Vishvamitra. This is a crucial test put to Rama by Vishvamitra in ascertaining whether Rama is the follower of dharma through elder men's orders or not. Rama eradicates Tataka basing on his own self-confidence.
closing: The materialists view this episode as a function of Rama in eradicating natural calamities like dust storms, pellet storms in an uncultivable land, on the line of the episode of Ahalya. In this episode Rama's discipline is also tested. Whether he simply follows what is instructed or whether he uses his own discretion, is the topic here. Rama coupled both and eradicates Tataka, tough he doubts for a while whether to eliminate a female. striivadhaH sahasaa na kartavyaH viruupakaraNaadi striidaNDanam eva prathamataH kriyate – dharmaakuutam This is required for the endowment of deadly missiles to Rama in coming chapters. Hence Vishvamitra asks Rama to depend upon his own self-confidence to undertake this deed as at 1-24-30b, 31a. On satisfying with the eligibility of Rama to receive missiles with this episode, Vishvamitra accords those deadly weapons later.

Thus, this is the 26th chapter in Bala Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
मुनेर्वचनमक्लीबं श्रुत्वा नरवरात्मजः |
राघवः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा प्रत्युवाच दृढव्रतः
verses.iast:
muner vacanam aklībam śrutvā naravarātmajaḥ |
rāghavaḥ prāñjaliḥ bhūtvā pratyuvāca dṛḍhavrataḥ
verses.translation: On hearing the words of that unfaltering sage about demoness Tataka, Raghava, best man's son who is firm in his vows, reverently adjoining his palms replied the sage.

glosses.meaning: among people, the best one, son of

verses.devanagari:
पितुर्वचननिर्देशात् पितुर्वचनगौरवात् |
वचनं कौशिकस्येति कर्तव्यमविशङ्कया
verses.iast:
pitur vacana nirdeśāt pitur vacana gauravāt |
vacanam kauśikasya iti kartavyam aviśañkayā
verses.translation: "Upon my father's order, upon my honour to my father's word, and looking upon this as the word of sage Kushi's son, my mentor, this task is definitely to be implemented.
notes: The third consideration is 'teacher's words' itarairapi guru śāsane sati aviśankayā dharmyam api tad uktam avaśyam kartavyam iti sūcitam - dharmākūtam itarairapi guru ??sane sati avi?ankay? dharmyam api tad uktam ava?yam kartavyam iti s?citam - dharm?k?tam hence, Rama cannot be heedless of the words of both his father and teacher.

glosses.meaning: sage's son [Vishvamitra,] word, thus as [deeming this as my mentor's word]

verses.devanagari:
अनुशिष्टोऽस्म्ययोध्यायां गुरुमध्ये महात्मना |
पित्रा दशरथेनाहं नावज्ञेयं च तद्वचः
verses.iast:
anuśiṣṭo asmi ayodhyāyām guru madhye mahātmanā |
pitrā daśarathena aham na avajñeyam ca tad vacaḥ
verses.translation: "What my great souled father Dasharatha directed me to do among elders in Ayodhya, that word too cannot be disregarded.
notes: Dasharatha bade Rama to do whatever assigned by Vishvamitra. Here Vishvamitra is assigning something ambiguous. Hence the dilemma between two instructions of two elderly people, and thus scriptures and practise confuse the young.

glosses.meaning: by great soul, by father, Dasharatha
that, word, cannot, to be disregarded, too.

verses.devanagari:
सोऽहं पितुर्वचः श्रुत्वा शासनाद्ब्रह्मवादिनः |
करिष्यामि न संदेहस्ताटकावधमुत्तमम्
verses.iast:
so'ham piturvacaḥ śrutvā śāsanād brahma vādinaḥ |
kariṣyāmi na sandehaḥ tāṭakā vadham uttamam
verses.translation: "Such as I am, I will undertake the primary duty of eliminating Tataka, according as the follower of father's words, and according to the instruction of a Brahma scholar, such as your are, without a doubt.
notes: Here Rama is in the same predicament as Arjuna in Maha Bharata. Arjuna's dilemma is to kill his own relatives, where Rama's is to kill a female at this juncture. What Krishna preaches in entire Bhagavad Gita is told in nutshell by sage Vishvamitra, i.e., 'do your duty as a Kshatriya, the ruling class, and protect virtue and eradicate vice, whether it is in the form of females or relatives.' atha viśvāmitro guruḥ - tasya vacanam avicāreṇa kartavyam - evam sati daśarathena api - kasuśiko yad vadati tat kartavyam - iti anuśiṣṭo rāmaḥ ekasya guror vacanam anullanghanīyam - guru dvaya anuśiṣṭam vacaḥ katham parihartum śakyata iti - strī vadha niṣedhe satya api tāḍakā vadham angīkṛtavān - dharmākūtam

glosses.meaning: such as I am, father's, words, having heard ? as a follower
Brahma, scholar ? such as you are
best [primary duty,] Tataka's, elimination, I wish to undertake

verses.devanagari:
गोब्राह्मणहितार्थाय देशस्यास्य हिताय च |
तव चैवाप्रमेयस्य वचनं कर्तुमुद्यतः
verses.iast:
go brāhmaṇa hitārthāya deśasya ca hitāya ca |
tava caiva aprameyasya vacanam kartum udyataḥ
verses.translation: "I am ready to effectuate the bidding of an inestimable sage like you, for the welfare of cows and Brahmans, and for the advantage of this province." So said Rama to sage Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: cows, and Brahmans, for welfare of

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा धनुर्मध्ये बध्वा मुष्टिमरिन्दमः |
ज्याघोषमकरोत्तीव्रं दिशः शब्देन नादयन्
verses.iast:
evam uk{}tvā dhanurmadhye badhvā muṣṭim arindamaḥ |
jyā ghoṣam akarot tīvram diśaḥ śabdena nādayan
verses.translation: Saying thus, Rama, the enemy-destroyer, clenched his left fist on the handgrip in the middle of the bow, and with the right he made a thunderous sound of the bowstring making all the directions to blast.

glosses.meaning: at bow's, middle [on handgrip,] clenching, his fist
by sound, directions, make them to blast

verses.devanagari:
तेन शब्देन वित्रस्तास्ताटकावनवासिनः |
ताटका च सुसंक्रुद्धा तेन शब्देन मोहिता
verses.iast:
tena śabdena vitrastāḥ tāṭakā vana vāsinaḥ |
tāṭakā ca susaṅkruddhā tena śabdena mohitā
verses.translation: By that sound the inhabitants of Tataka forest are startled, and even Tataka is stupefied by that sound, and she is intolerably infuriated at it.

verses.devanagari:
तं शब्दमभिनिध्याय राक्षसी क्रोधमूर्च्छिता |
श्रुत्वा चाभ्यद्रवत् क्रुद्धा यतः शब्दो विनिस्सृतः
verses.iast:
tam śabdam abhinidhyāya rākṣasī krodha mūrcitā |
śrutvā ca abhyadravat kruddhā yatra śabdo vinissṛtaḥ
verses.translation: She who is convulsed in anger to hear that sound gave attention to the direction wherefrom it emerged and she rancorously rushed thereto.

glosses.meaning: thinking awhile - giving attention to the pathway it emerged

verses.devanagari:
तां दृष्ट्वा राघवः क्रुद्धां विकृतां विकृताननाम् |
प्रमाणेनातिवृद्धां च लक्ष्मणं सोऽभ्यभाषत
verses.iast:
tām dṛṣṭvā rāghavaḥ kruddhām vikṛtām vikṛta ānanām |
pramāṇena ati vṛddhām ca lakṣmaṇam so'bhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: Raghava on seeing that monstrous-looking demoness with a distorted face and who by proportions is very gigantic, furthermore infuriated, spoke to Lakshmana.

verses.devanagari:
पश्य लक्ष्मण यक्षिण्या भैरवं दारुणं वपुः |
भिद्येरन् दर्शनादस्या भीरूणां हृदयानि च
verses.iast:
paśya lakṣmaṇa yakṣiṇyā bhairavam dāruṇam vapuḥ |
bhidyeran darśanāt asyā bhīrūṇām hṛdayāni ca
verses.translation: "Lakshmana, see that yakshii's grisly and ghastly physique, seeing which hearts of cowards are prone to burst.

verses.devanagari:
एतां पश्य दुराधर्षां मायाबलसमन्विताम् |
विनिवृत्तां करोम्यद्य हृतकर्णाग्रनासिकाम्
verses.iast:
etām paśya durādharṣām māyā bala samanvitām |
vinivṛttām karomi adya hṛta karṇāgra nāsikām
verses.translation: " She is unstoppable and has magical powers, is't, you may see now how I will make her to readily retreat by lopping off her ears and the tip of nose.

glosses.meaning: taking away [lopping off,] [her] ears, tip of the nose

verses.devanagari:
न ह्येनामुत्सहे हन्तुं स्त्रीस्वभावेन रक्षिताम् |
वीर्यं चास्या गतिं चापि हन्यतामिति मे मतिः
verses.iast:
na hi enām utsahe hantum strī svabhāvena rakṣitām |
vīryam ca asyā gatim ca eva hanyatām iti me matiḥ
verses.translation: "As it is her feminineness is protecting her, and I too I do not really attempt to kill her, but I intend to terminate her impudence and mobility.

glosses.meaning: female, by virtue of ? feminineness, [she is] protected
her, to eliminate, not, I attempt, really
be terminated, thus is, my, intention.

verses.devanagari:
एवं ब्रुवाणे रामे तु ताटका क्रोधमूर्च्छिता |
उद्यम्य बाहू गर्जन्ती राममेवाभ्यधावत
verses.iast:
evam bruvāṇe rāme tu tāṭakā krodha mūrchitā |
udyaṃya bāhūm garjantī rāmam eva abhyadhāvata
verses.translation: While Rama is still speaking that way, convulsed in anger Tataka roaringly rushed towards Rama alone, swinging her arms.

glosses.meaning: by Rama, this way, while saying

verses.devanagari:
विश्वामित्रस्तु ब्रह्मर्षिर्हुंकारेणाभिभर्त्स्य ताम् |
स्वस्ति राघवयोरस्तु जयं चैवाभ्यभाषत
verses.iast:
viśvāmitrastu brahmarṣiḥ huṅkāreṇā abhibhartsya tām |
svasti rāghavayoḥ astu jayam ca eva abhyabhāṣata
verses.translation: But the Brahma-sage Vishvamitra daunted sounded her off and said to Rama and Lakshmana, "let you be safe, and be victorious."

verses.devanagari:
उद्धुन्वाना रजो घोरं ताटका राघवावुभौ |
रजो मेघेन महता मुहूर्तं सा व्यमोहयत्
verses.iast:
ud dhunvānā rajo ghoram tāṭakā rāghavau ubhau |
rajo meghena mahatā muhūrtam sā vyamohayat
verses.translation: Flinging up dreadful dust on those two Raghavaa-s, Tataka baffled them for a while with a massive cloud of dust.

verses.devanagari:
ततो मायां समास्थाय शिलावर्षेण राघवौ |
अवाकिरत् सुमहता ततश्चुक्रोध राघवः
verses.iast:
tato māyām samāsthāya śilā varṣeṇa rāghavau |
avākirat sumahatā tataḥ cukrodha rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: Then taking hold of witchery she inundated both the Raghava-s with highly torrential stone rain, by which Rama became indignant.

verses.devanagari:
शिलावर्षं महत्तस्याः शरवर्षेण राघवः |
प्रतिवार्योपधावन्त्याः करौ चिच्छेद पत्रिभिः
verses.iast:
śilā varṣam mahat tasyāḥ śara varṣeṇa rāghavaḥ |
prativāryo apadhāvantyāḥ karau ciccheda patribhiḥ
verses.translation: On forestalling her effusive stone storming with his arrow storm, Rama even mutilated both of her arms with arrows while she rushed towards them.

verses.devanagari:
ततश्च्छिन्नभुजां श्रान्तामभ्याशे परिगर्जतीम् |
सौमित्रिरकरोत् क्रोधाद् हृतकर्णाग्रनासिकाम्
verses.iast:
tataḥ cchinna bhujām śrāntām abhyāśe parigarjatīm |
saumitriḥ akarot krodhāt hṛta karṇāgra nāsikām
verses.translation: With her arms severed and fatigued she started to roar extremely at the nearby, and then provoked Lakshmana made her to loose her ears and the tip of nose by cutting them off.

glosses.meaning: to loose ears, tip of nose

verses.devanagari:
कामरूपधरा सा तु कृत्वा रूपाण्यनेकशः |
अन्तर्धानं गता यक्षी मोहयन्ती स्वमायया
अश्मवर्षं विमुंचन्ती भैरवं विचचार सा ||
verses.iast:
kāma rūpadharā sā tu kṛtvā rūpāṇi anekaśaḥ |
antardhānam gatā yaxī mohayanti sva māyayā
aśma varṣam vimuñcantī bhairavam vicacāra sā ||
verses.translation: That guise changer vanished after variously altering her aspects, and then on baffling them with her illusoriness and discharging stone storms she moved about appallingly.

glosses.meaning: she, by wish, guise, changer, but
variously, her forms, on making - altering

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तावश्मवर्षेण कीर्यमाणौ समन्ततः
दृष्ट्वा गाधिसुतः श्रीमानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
tataḥ tau aśma varṣeṇa kīryamāṇau samantataḥ
dṛṣṭvā gādhi sutaḥ śrīīmān idam vacanam abravīt |
verses.translation: And on seeing both Rama and Lakshmana who are being overspread by storms of stones from all-over, then the illustrious sage Vishvamitra spoke this sentence.

glosses.meaning: all-over, by stones, storm, overspread by

verses.devanagari:
अलं ते घृणया राम पापैषा दुष्टचारिणी
यज्ञविघ्नकरी यक्षी पुरा वर्धेत मायया |
verses.iast:
alam te ghṛṇayā rāma pāpā eṣā duṣṭa cāriṇī
yajña vighna karī yaxī purā vardheta māyayā |
verses.translation: "Enough is your compassion Rama, she is a sinister, behaviourally malevolent, a hinderer of rituals, and this yakshii gets a grip on herself in a short time by her illusory powers.

glosses.meaning: in a short time, regains ? gets a grip on herself.

verses.devanagari:
वध्यतां तावदेवैषा पुरा संध्या प्रवर्तते
रक्षांसि संध्याकाले तु दुर्धर्षाणि भवन्ति हि |
verses.iast:
vadhyatām tāvat eva eṣā purā sandhyā prava.rtate
raxāṃsi sandhyā kāle tu du.rdharṣāṇi bhavanti hi |
verses.translation: "Sun is going to set in a short time, and only before that time she shall be destroyed, for demons at dusk and afterwards become unassailable, indeed." So said sage Viswamitra to Rama.

glosses.meaning: sunset, in short time, sets in

verses.devanagari:
इत्युक्तस्स तु तां यक्षीमश्मवृष्ट्याभिवर्षिणीम्
दर्शयन् शब्दवेधित्वं तां रुरोध स सायकैः |
verses.iast:
iti uk{}taḥ sa tu tām yaxīm aśma vṛṣṭyā abhivarṣaṇīm
darśayan śabda vedhitvam tām rurodha sa sāyakaiḥ |
verses.translation: When Vishvamitra addressed him thus, Rama displaying his capacity in sonic archery forestalled that yakshii who has gone into invisibility and storming stone-storms, with his arrows.

verses.devanagari:
सा रुद्धा बाणजालेन मायाबलसमन्विता
अभिदुद्राव काकुत्स्थं लक्षमणं च विनेषुदी ||
verses.iast:
sā ruddhā bāṇa jālena māyā bala samanvitā
abhi dudrāva kākutstham laxamaṇam ca vineṣudī ||
verses.translation: And when the arrays of arrows obstructed her who possesses illusional powers, she dashed towards Rama and Lakshmana blaring stridently.

verses.devanagari:
तामापतन्तीं वेगेन विक्रान्तामशनीमिव
शरेणोरसि विव्याध सा पपात ममार च |
verses.iast:
tām āpatantīm vegena vikrāntām aśanīm iva
śareṇa urasi vivyādha sā papāta mamāra ca |
verses.translation: And Rama struck an arrow in her chest who is invading and speedily swooping down like a thunderbolt, and thus she is readily felled down and totally dropped dead, too.

glosses.meaning: she who is coming and falling ? swooping down
her, with arrow, on chest, struck

verses.devanagari:
तां हतां भीमसंकाशां दृष्ट्वा सुरपतिस्तदा
साधु साध्विति काकुत्स्थं सुराश्चाप्यभिपूजयन् |
verses.iast:
tām hatām bhīma saṅkāśām dṛṣṭvā surapatiḥ tadā
sādhu sādhviti kākutstham surāḥ ca api abhipūjayan |
verses.translation: On seeing her who is horrendous in her shape is eliminated Indra and other gods have highly esteemed Rama saying, ?admirable, admirable is this act.

glosses.meaning: admirable, admirable, thus [this act of felling her]

verses.devanagari:
उवाच परमप्रीतः सहस्राक्षः पुरन्दरः
सुराश्च सर्वे संहृष्टा विश्वामित्रमथाब्रुवन् |
verses.iast:
uvāca parama prītaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ purandaraḥ
surāḥ ca sarve saṃhṛṣṭā viśvāmitram atha abruvan |
verses.translation: The thousand eyed and the destroyer of enemy?s citadels Indra then spoke with high satisfaction, and even all of the gods are gladdened and said to Vishvamitra this way.

verses.devanagari:
मुने कौशिक भद्रं ते सेन्द्राः सर्वे मरुद्गणाः
तोषिताः कर्मणानेन स्नेहं दर्शय राघवे |
verses.iast:
mune kauśika bhadram te saha indrāḥ sarve marud gaṇāḥ
toṣitāḥ karmaṇā anena sneham darśaya rāghave |
verses.translation: "Oh, sage Vishvamitra, you are blessed, all the groups of wind-gods along with Indra are pleased, so you please show more concern for Raghava.

verses.devanagari:
प्रजापतेः कृशाश्वस्य पुत्रान्सत्यपराक्रमान्
तपोबलभृतो ब्रह्मन् राघवाय निवेदय |
verses.iast:
prajāpateḥ kṛśāśvasya putrān satya parākramān
tapo bala bhṛto brahman rāghavāya nivedaya |
verses.translation: "The sons of Prajapati Krishasva who are valiant by their virtue and who possess ascetic strength, oh, Brahman, they may be offered to Raghava. [1-26-29,b, 30a]
notes: These are the sons like missiles of Krishaashava Prajaapati. About them, the divine weaponry and their birth, c.f. 21st sarga/chapter, verse 10 to 20.

verses.devanagari:
पात्रभूतश्च ते ब्रह्मंस्तवानुगमने रतः
कर्तव्यं सुमहत्कर्म सुराणां राजसूनुना |
verses.iast:
pātrabhūtaḥ ca te brahman tava anugamane rataḥ
kartavyam sumahat karma surāṇām rāja sūnunā |
verses.translation: "Rama is steadfast in following your assignments and thus he is the worthy receiver of those missiles, and this prince has to accomplish a very great deed of gods.? So said gods to Vishvamitra.

glosses.meaning: your, in tow, going ? following, steadfast ? Rama [follower of your assignments]
to you, befitting one ? worthy receiver

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा सुराः सर्वे जग्मुर्हृष्टा विहायसम्
विश्वामित्रं पूजयन्तस्ततः संध्या प्रवर्तते |
verses.iast:
evam uk{}tvā surāḥ sarve jagmur hṛṣṭā vihāyasam
viśvāmitram pūjayan tataḥ sandhyā prava.rtate |
verses.translation: All the gods on saying thus and on extolling Vishvamitra they contentedly returned to heavens, and then the sunset has come to pass.

verses.devanagari:
ततो मुनिवरः प्रीतस्ताटकावधतोषितः
मूर्ध्नि राममुपाघ्राय इदं वचनमब्रवीत् |
verses.iast:
tato munivaraḥ prītaḥ tāṭakā vadha toṣitaḥ
mūrdhni rāmam upāghrāya idam vacanam abravīt |
verses.translation: That best sage is satisfied with Rama and gladdened for the eradication of Tataka kissed the forehead of and then said this sentence.

verses.devanagari:
इहाद्य रजनीं राम वसेम शुभदर्शन
श्वः प्रभाते गमिष्यामस्तदाश्रमपदं मम |
verses.iast:
iha adya rajanīm rāma vasāma śubha darśana
śvaḥ prabhāte gamiṣyāmaḥ tad āśrama padam mama |
verses.translation: "Here we stay for tonight, Rama, the august one for a gaze, and tomorrow morning we will go to that hermitage of mine.? So said Vishvamitra to Rama.

glosses.meaning: oh, august one, to gaze at, Rama
mine, that, to hermitage, we will proceed.

verses.devanagari:
विश्वामित्रवचः श्रुत्वा हृष्टो दशरथात्मजः
उवास रजनीं तत्र ताटकाया वने सुखम् |
verses.iast:
viśvāmitraḥ vacaḥ śrutvā hṛṣṭo daśaradhātmajaḥ
uvāsa rajanīm tatra tāṭakāyā vane sukham |
verses.translation: On listening sage Vishvamitra's words, Dasharatha's son Rama, comfortably stayed that night there in that forest of Tataka.

verses.devanagari:
मुक्तशापं वनं तच्च तस्मिन्नेव तदाहनि |
रमणीयं विबभ्राज यथा चैत्ररथं वनम्
verses.iast:
muk{}ta śāpam vanam tat ca tasmin eva tat āhani |
ramaṇīyam vibabhrāja yathā caitra ratham vanam
verses.translation: On that very day alone that forest of Tataka too is released from the curse, and it shone forth like the luxurious heavenly garden of Kubera, namely Chiatra Ratha. [1-26-35b, c]

verses.devanagari:
निहत्य तां यक्षसुतां स रामः
प्रशस्यमानः सुरसिद्धसङ्घैः |
उवास तस्मिन्मुनिना सहैव
प्रभातवेलां प्रतिबोध्यमानः
verses.iast:
nihatya tām yaxa sutām sa rāmaḥ
praśasyamānaḥ sura siddha sanghaiḥ |
uvāsa tasmin muninā saha eva
prabhāta velām prati bodhyamānaḥ
verses.translation: Rama while being eulogised by the groups of celestials and liberated Souls for complete elimination of yaksha's daughter, namely Tataka, stayed there along with the sage only to be awakened by the next day?s sunrise.

glosses.meaning: by celestials, liberated Souls, and their groups
being addressed being awakened by sunrise
